summary: community.general keycloak_authz_permission(_info), keycloak_client, client_rolemapping, client_rolescope and clientscope are now redirects that need middleware_automation.keycloak installed.
questions: Why does keycloak_client fail with a redirect error?
Do I need to install middleware_automation.keycloak for keycloak_clientscope?

answer_card.title: Keycloak redirects in community.general (part 2)
answer_card.answer_md:
These community.general modules are now **redirects** to `middleware_automation.keycloak`. The redirect only works if you **install `middleware_automation.keycloak`**:

```bash
ansible-galaxy collection install middleware_automation.keycloak
```

Affected modules (each maps to `middleware_automation.keycloak.<name>`):

`keycloak_authz_permission`, `keycloak_authz_permission_info`, `keycloak_client`, `keycloak_client_rolemapping`, `keycloak_client_rolescope`, `keycloak_clientscope` (→ `keycloak_client_scope`)
